items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: they had a fella who used to play, Al Tober, I don't know his name.

ctx.x: I don't know what that means. I know it's just a nickname they call him.

It must have a meaning though, but I didn't know it. Now he played in the Excelsior band. He played baritone and they had a fella who used to play, Al Tober, I don't know his name. You know y'all never get much on the Excelsior band.
No, not very many of those fellas are having.
